verdict.rationale: Statsig is a SaaS platform that ingests customer event and user data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy. The MCP, OpenAI and AI-evals items are about using AI with Statsig, not about protecting data from training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
